=== Possibly faulty data and open points ===
* Gap list dated the Valley View Mall event 8 August 2004 and the V-Set 8 event 2 January 2005 at Y2Komics; the posts give 7 August 2004 (Dallas) and Sunday 9 January 2005 (College Station; the form's date field says 01/02/2005). The draft uses 7 August and 9 January.
* The 9 January 2005 venue was a private home; the address was left out.
* The tournament rows come from his own announcements; only the 31 January 2004 event is confirmed held (Robert Stokes's post).
